status: EXPLORATORY; no formal risk guarantee; test folds examined earlier; design chosen after a previous test-half analysis
definition: alpha = maximum acceptable error rate among automatically accepted cells
threshold_rule: candidate tau = every distinct calibration confidence; lowest tau with one-sided 90% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on calibration selective risk <= alpha; refer all if none qualifies
score: max probability of the frozen ensemble with its frozen full-calibration temperature
test_use: thresholds frozen and saved before test predictions are read; test applied once

tests.method: seeds averaged within fold; Nadeau-Bengio corrected paired t (df=4); Holm within alpha x outcome
